description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +30%, RES +25% (25s)] to all allies, [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ballad Mode I (Garnet - Holy)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ballad Mode I (Garnet - Holy)
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, cast time x2.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities, Summoning and Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Power of Fate after casting Summoning and Bard abilities (max 2)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ballad Mode II (Garnet - Holy)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ballad Mode II (Garnet - Holy)
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Summoning and Bard abilities, grants Summoning smart ether 2 and [Dualcast Summoning 1] to all allies after using Summoning and Bard abilities, damages the user for 99% current HP after using Summoning and Bard abilities, grants [HP Stock (10000)] to the user after using Summoning and Bard abilities

description.name: HP Stock (10000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 10000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
